title: Hydropower research spatial coordinate policy
design_rule: Do not force the entire Nepal research database into one projected CRS. Preserve source CRS, normalize public/web geometry to WGS 84 longitude/latitude, and use geography or an appropriate verified projected CRS for metric analysis.

canonical_storage.name: WGS 84
canonical_storage.reason: GeoJSON and web maps use longitude/latitude; this also keeps river lines, catchment polygons and hydropower points interoperable.

survey_department_projection_model.reference_note: Survey Department publications describe three 3-degree TM zones for Nepal. Do not assign an unverified single national projected SRID to all features.

query_policy.national_intersection_and_containment: Use geom_wgs84 with a GiST index for topological queries such as project-in-catchment and river-intersects-catchment.
query_policy.national_distance_and_area: Use PostGIS geography for spheroidal distance/area when a single national planar CRS would cross official TM zones.
query_policy.local_engineering_metric_queries: Transform to the verified Nepal TM/MUTM zone appropriate to the feature longitude or to another explicitly documented engineering CRS before planar length, buffer or area calculations.
query_policy.source_crs_preservation: Every imported geometry stores source_crs, source_dataset, source_feature_id, transformation_method and transformation_date so the WGS84 geometry can be reproduced.
